description: This source file provides database utilities and schema initialization functions for a mobile service web backend. It manages SQLite database connections, schema creation, and data access functions related to services, customer requests, bookings, and site content.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Returns the file path to the SQLite database, using environment variable SQLITE_DB or defaulting to a local database file.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Creates database tables if they do not exist and seeds default site content entries.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Retrieves all service records ordered by sort_order and id.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs for specified site content keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer request record and returns its ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new booking record and returns its ID.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent bookings, default limit 200.

ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> int:$/

ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
